title: fix(kanban): a list view board laned by a lookup counts and totals each whole lane, and draws a lane past the first page
body:
Fixes #37327
Clause-②: yes (widening) — @object-ui/i18n kanban.notLoaded
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:列表里的看板按没有选项的字段分泳道时,泳道标题的数量、底部的计数和标题旁的合计,现在按整条泳道的全部记录计算(例如 30,不再是第一页的 13);按查找字段分道时,记录全在第一页之后的泳道也会画出来,并写明有多少张卡片没有加载。
- 为什么做:看板泳道统计这一族的收尾,上一张卡修好了底部的合计/平均/最小/最大,这里补上数量、合计和缺失的泳道,替按客户分组看商机的销售用户解决数字偏小的问题。
- 出错会怎样:数据源不支持分组统计时,数字退回为当前页的数字并标上「+」,不会显示错误的整数;可直接撤回。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

On ListView's rows-handed board (lanes from the data: a lane field with no options, such as a lookup, one page of records handed in together with `laneStatisticQuery`; the lanes past the page are drawn for a lookup only), the board's one grouped lane read now answers every lane figure the page cannot:

- `KanbanLaneStatistic.ts`: `compileLaneReadQuery` generalises the #36871 read. Beside the view's statistic it can ask each lane's `COUNT(*)` (alias `count`, `LANE_COUNT_ALIAS`) and the `SUM` of the view's `summarizeField`; it is still ONE grouped aggregate per board. `compileLaneStatisticQuery` delegates to it and compiles the same query as before. New readers: `readLaneCounts` (null on a partial answer) and `readLaneKeys` (the lanes the answer names, null on a partial answer); `LaneFigureReading` takes an optional `alias`.
- `ObjectKanban.tsx`: on the hosted, flat board (`hostLaneRead`) the read is asked whether or not the view draws a statistic, with the count and, where the header total is drawn, the total. The read now waits for the object definition, so it is asked once. The answer gives `hostLaneCounts` (a new board prop), `headerTotals` (the header summary's `figures`), and the lanes past the page: lane keys the page does not hold are appended after the page's lanes (`boardColumns`), titled by one read of the referenced records on the lane field's target object, by the key until that answers.
- `KanbanImpl.tsx`: `KanbanBoardProps.laneCounts`. A flat lane writes the whole count (`wholeLaneCount`); while the read is pending or cannot answer (no door, a refusal, a partial answer) it writes the page count marked `+`. The foot `count` and the column limit read the same count. `LaneTotal` reads the whole lane's sum off `figures`, else the page's sum marked `+`.
- `KanbanBoardCore.tsx`: forwards `laneCounts` (a prop, never a schema key).
- `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` (11 packs): new key `kanban.notLoaded`; `count-families-11445.test.ts` lists it as a count-neutral tally.
- `.changeset/37327-kanban-lookup-lane-whole-counts.md`: patch, `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` and `@object-ui/i18n`. `Clause-②: yes (widening)`: `kanban.notLoaded` joins the exported `TranslationKeys` type; nothing is removed or renamed. `Metadata-protocol: none`.

Mechanism readings (dispatch A1 to A3):

- A1: whole-lane figures, no marking. The count and the total ride the read #36871 already asks: one grouped aggregate per board, never one per lane. On a board with no lane statistic this is one new read per board where #36871 asked none; one more read (the referenced records' titles) runs only when a lane past the page exists.
- A2: the lane set past the page comes from the grouped read's group keys (`readLaneKeys`), not from the page.
- A3: `ListView.tsx` is untouched. The fix lives in `ObjectKanban.tsx` and `KanbanLaneStatistic.ts`: the claim's file surface put "the grouped lane read #36871 added" in `KanbanBoardCore.tsx`, but #36871 put it in `ObjectKanban.tsx`. `overlap-check` at head: clean; #37436 shares `ObjectKanban.tsx` and merges cleanly.

### Rework round 1 (seat record 7188888406, note 7188910951)

- **S1**: a lane drawn from the read with no card on the page says `Cards not loaded: 10` instead of `No cards`. New key `kanban.notLoaded` in all eleven packs (`Label: N` in each, so it is listed as a count-neutral tally in `count-families-11445.test.ts`).
- **S2**: restricted. Past-page lanes are drawn only over a lane field that names the object it references (`laneTargetObject`); any other option-less lane field (text, number, boolean, date) draws the page's lanes only. Whole counts and totals still apply to every option-less field, falling to marked page figures where a key does not match.
- **S3**: pins for a refused read and a cut read (`hasMore`) on the real ListView board, the filter scope of the count read in the rig, the search pair and filter of a count-only read in the plugin-kanban suite, and unit pins for `readLaneCounts` / `readLaneKeys`.
- **S4**: a lane read's `sum` (the header total and the #36871 foot `sum`, folded groups included) is printed without binary residue (`withoutBinaryResidue`, 15 significant digits: the server's SUM carries no inputs to measure the widest scale from). Float pin: 0.1 + 0.2 reads `0.3`.
- **S6**: the title read projects `$select: ['id', ...title fields]` (the lane field's `displayField`, then the target's name field; every field when the target has only a legacy `titleFormat`). A code comment says why it is an id-IN read: the public aggregate door refuses a dotted `groupBy`, and the list is bounded by one page of groups.
- **N3**: changeset reworded: "lanes from the data" for counts and totals, "lookup" for past-page lanes, the Uncategorized lane's whole count stated, `@object-ui/i18n` patch added.

## Tests

New top-level describe in the #36871 rig `ui/packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/listKanbanEveryRecord-12619.test.tsx`: 70 deals, 0 to 59 alternating over `acc-a` / `acc-b`, 60 to 69 all `acc-c` (past the first page of 25). A rig self-check asserts 25 cards (13 / 12) drawn. Each pin has a control over a source with no grouped door:

- Header counts read 30 / 30, never 13 / 12, off ONE read asking only `COUNT(*)`. A foot `count` reads 30 / 30. CONTROL: no door reads `13+` / `12+`.
- A lane for `acc-c` is drawn, titled `Cyan Corp` (its account), with 0 cards and count 10. CONTROL: no door draws no such lane.
- The `summarizeField` header total reads 870 / 900 / 645, never 156 / 144, off the same one read (`count` + `sum_amount`). CONTROL: no door reads `156+` / `144+`.

Round 1 adds, in the rig: refused-read and cut-read CONTROLs (`156+` / `144+`, `13+` / `12+`, no past-page lane), filter scope (25 / 25 / 10 under amount above 9), `Cards not loaded: 10`, a text-laned board (30 / 30, no `bronze` lane), a float total (`0.3`), and the projected title read. In `ObjectKanban.laneStatistic-36370.test.tsx`: the count-only read's filter and search pair, and a `readLaneCounts` / `readLaneKeys` / sum-fold describe.

<details><summary>Round 1 ablations (head 866e4bd1bb, baseline 55/55 over the rig and the plugin-kanban suite, every leg restored to HEAD, git diff HEAD empty)</summary>

- S1 `notLoaded` forced false: 1 failed (the not-loaded pin).
- S2 `laneTargetObject` gate removed: 1 failed (the text-laned board draws `bronze`).
- S4 `withoutBinaryResidue(total)` changed to `total`: 2 failed (the unit fold and the rig's float total).
- S6 `$select` spread emptied: 1 failed (the title-read pin).
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations (committed first, ablation-replace.mjs on ObjectKanban.tsx, restored blob a099dc1b1a36 == HEAD each time)</summary>

The vitest config aliases `@object-ui/plugin-kanban` to its `src/`, so no dist rebuild sits between mutation and run.

- counts: `laneCounts={hostLaneCounts}` changed to `laneCounts={undefined}`. Anchor 1 to 0, blob a099dc1b1a36 to afe97a7a4ed1. 4 failed / 12 passed: both count pins, the count CONTROL and the past-page lane's count.
- lanes: `extraLaneIds.length === 0` changed to `extraLaneIds.length >= 0`. Blob to 41dee11b0e25. 2 failed / 14 passed: the past-page lane pin and the header-total pin, which reads that lane.
- total: the header summary's `figures` spread changed to an empty spread. Blob to db34e1679cef. 1 failed / 15 passed: the header-total pin.
</details>

<details><summary>Suites and type-checks</summary>

- `vitest run packages/plugin-kanban/ packages/plugin-list/` at 1cd895021c: Test Files 275 passed, Tests 2651 passed.
- After merging origin/main (head 89e65abb46, closure rebuilt): `plugin-kanban` and `app-shell` `type-check` exit 0. The rig, `ListView.kanbanOwnsLanes-12619` and `ObjectKanban.laneStatistic-36370`: Test Files 3 passed, Tests 56 passed.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

Carried on cards (seat finding S5), not fixed here:
- #37516: the Uncategorized lane is not drawn when every empty-lookup record sits past page one.
- #37517: loading the cards of a past-page lane.
- #37326 (widened, 7188972467): swimlane page counts on this board.

- Accepted nits, unchanged: N1 (`+` over-marks a whole page when no read answers), N2 (whole counts unmarked while a re-ask is in flight), N4 (one refused aggregation drops the counts too; a lane field named `count` compiles to no read), N5 (raw-key titles for unreadable or deleted references; extra-lane order follows the answer).

## Verification

- Read first: `ObjectKanban.tsx` at `hostLaneRead` / `laneStatisticQuestion` / `extraLaneIds` / `boardColumns`; `KanbanImpl.tsx` at `wholeLaneCount` and `LaneTotal`; `compileLaneReadQuery` in `KanbanLaneStatistic.ts`.
- Two-minute check: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/__tests__/listKanbanEveryRecord-12619.test.tsx`. Expect 23 passed, with the 37327 describe's 14 pins.
